what.text: This page follows refugees from Russia living in Spain, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3689 Russian refugees in Spain, 3.7% of all refugees from Russia.
France hosts the most Russian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Russia in 2023 and 2024, with LSR, RDK and Wagner as opponents.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 12 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
These are year-end totals for Spain only, reported to UNHCR.
